messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: My model does not compile correctly
parts:
On Thursday, March 7, 2013 1:30:19 PM UTC-5, Keith O'Rourke wrote: 
> library(Rcpp)
> library(inline)
> system("g++ --version")
G__~1.EXE (GCC) 4.6.2
Copyright (C) 2011 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
This is free software; see the source for copying conditions. There is NO
warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

This is g++ 4.6.2. I believe the officially supported compiler version for CRAN / Rcpp / Stan on Windows is a mingw prerelease of 4.6.3, which can be downloaded here

http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/

Either the 30 or the 215 version should work with Stan.

Ben
